private_watchlist.name: TerraPower
private_watchlist.note: Announced Aug 14 in Seoul: selected Hyundai E&C as EPC contractor for up to 8 future Natrium reactors with completion/price/performance guarantees, and signed a term sheet with SK Innovation to develop Korea's first commercial Natrium plant. Also marked the formal construction start of flagship Kemmerer Unit 1 (WY), targeting operation ~2031, part of Meta's ~6.6 GW nuclear commitment.

private_watchlist.name: X-energy
private_watchlist.note: Xe-100 high-temp gas reactor; Amazon leading a $700M investment for up to 12 Xe-100 units. Q2 (Aug 13): revenue+grants +154% YoY to $54.6M but EPS -$0.15 missed -$0.09 est. DOE has since confirmed an additional $1B in ARDP cost-share for the Long Mott project (total $2.115B); shares jumped over 13% on the news. Liquidity $1.9B, no debt.

private_watchlist.name: Kairos Power
private_watchlist.note: Google's first-ever corporate agreement to develop a US SMR fleet — up to 500 MW across 6-7 units; first commercial Hermes unit targeted for 2030, full fleet by 2035. Broke ground on the Hermes 2 demonstration plant in Oak Ridge in April 2026.

private_watchlist.name: Commonwealth Fusion
private_watchlist.note: MIT spinout; raised another $1B on Jul 30, 2026 (~$4B total raised) from pension funds, sovereign wealth funds and strategic investors. SPARC demonstration machine in Devens, MA now targeting first operation/net-energy-gain milestone around late 2026 or early 2027.

private_watchlist.name: Helion
private_watchlist.note: Altman-backed; Polaris prototype demonstrated measurable deuterium-tritium fusion at a 150M°C plasma temperature (announced Aug 20) — the first private fusion device in its class to clear that threshold. Closed a $465M Series G in June 2026 valuing the company at $15.5B; Orion plant under construction to deliver 50MW under its Microsoft PPA by 2029.

private_watchlist.name: Holtec Nuclear
private_watchlist.note: Spent-fuel storage & decommissioning incumbent building SMR-300; continuing to amend its registration statement (latest DRS/A filed in August) for an estimated ~$2.0B Nasdaq IPO (JPM, Guggenheim, Goldman, Citi, BofA leading). Share count and price range still not set as of Aug 23.

bear_case.title: A mandatory hearing still isn't a permit
bear_case.description: The NRC's Aug 13 Clinch River hearing was only the final procedural step before commissioners vote — the public comment window stays open through Aug 27, and no construction permit has actually issued. Zero advanced SMRs deliver commercial power anywhere in the world; first-of-a-kind builds historically run over budget and schedule.

bear_case.title: The flagship SMR name is drawing more Sell calls, not fewer
bear_case.description: Citi initiated NuScale coverage at Sell with a $6.50 price target and Texas Capital cut to $12 after Q2 revenue collapsed to $75K from $8M a year ago — even as CEO John Hopkins calls the TVA/ENTRA1 6-8GW talks 'extremely encouraging.' A still-non-binding mega-deal is being used to offset genuinely bearish sell-side math, and a fresh $750M ATM keeps diluting the float underneath it.

bear_case.title: A record backlog didn't save GE Vernova from an earnings miss
bear_case.description: GEV's Q2 orders jumped 88% YoY to a record $176B backlog, yet adjusted EPS of $2.47 missed the $3.04 estimate and shares fell 3.5% on Aug 20. Backlog size is not the same as near-term earnings conversion — a caution for any nuclear-adjacent industrial story being valued on order momentum alone.

bear_case.title: Even 'de-risked' balance sheets aren't immune to cost overruns
bear_case.description: Centrus's Q1 net income fell 63.2% YoY on rising Piketon expansion costs, UBS cut its price target to $170 from $195, and shares have fallen from a $464 high to the $176-187 range despite a growing $3.0B HALEU backlog. Meanwhile Oklo's FY26 cash-use guide keeps climbing ($120-150M, up from $80-100M) even after a real first-criticality milestone — profitable-sounding contracts and technical wins don't automatically translate into controlled costs.

catalysts.title: NuScale Q2 draws fresh Sell/cut ratings as TVA/ENTRA1 talks turn 'extremely encouraging'
catalysts.description: Citi cut its price target to $6.50 (Sell) and Texas Capital to $12 (Buy) after Q2 revenue collapsed to $75K from $8M a year ago. CEO John Hopkins called the tenor of TVA's public comments on a possible 6-8GW ENTRA1 deployment 'extremely encouraging,' but the pathway remains non-binding. Shares traded near 52-week lows in the high-$8 to low-$9 range.

catalysts.title: Helion's Polaris hits 150M°C, demonstrates measurable D-T fusion
catalysts.description: Helion's seventh-generation Polaris prototype became the first private fusion device in its class to demonstrate measurable deuterium-tritium fusion at a plasma temperature of roughly 150 million degrees Celsius, a real technical step toward its 2028 Microsoft PPA target.

catalysts.title: Cameco jumps 7.2% to $102.51 as Truist lifts price target to $130
catalysts.description: The move followed continued confirmation that Cigar Lake is back at full production (resumed Jul 14) and that Cameco's ownership stake in the mine has risen to 57.418% after closing the TEPCO acquisition — physical tightening keeps showing up in the shares.

catalysts.title: TerraPower signs Hyundai as builder for up to 8 Natrium reactors, adds Korea term sheet
catalysts.description: During a Seoul visit, TerraPower selected Hyundai Engineering & Construction as EPC contractor for up to eight future Natrium reactors with completion, price and performance guarantees, and signed a term sheet with SK Innovation to pursue Korea's first commercial Natrium plant. The trip also marked the formal construction start of Kemmerer Unit 1.

catalysts.title: GE Vernova posts record $176B backlog but misses on EPS
catalysts.description: Q2 orders rose 88% YoY to $24.2B, pushing backlog to a record $176B, and full-year revenue guidance was raised to $45.5-46.5B. But adjusted EPS of $2.47 missed the $3.04 estimate and shares fell as much as 3.5% (Aug 20) on profit-taking despite the Blue Energy Texas nuclear-plus-gas project advancing to engineering and licensing.

catalysts.title: Clinch River mandatory NRC hearing convenes; comment window extends to Aug 27
catalysts.description: NRC's mandatory uncontested hearing on TVA's Clinch River BWRX-300 construction permit was held in Oak Ridge, TN, following NRC staff's June safety-evaluation recommendation. Commissioners' formal permit decision — which would be a first for a commercial SMR — remains pending, with public comments accepted through Aug 27.
